OpsPager: Heads up team — planning a regional rolling maintenance for inference serving nodes. Tentative windows: NA 2026-03-23 00:00-01:30 UTC, EU 2026-03-23 01:30-03:00 UTC, APAC 2026-03-23 03:00-04:00 UTC. This thread is for readiness checks, status page copy, customer notice, and on-call routing. Please ack and call out ownership for each region. :spiral_calendar_pad:

IncidentBot: Maintenance created (ID: mnt-20260323-01) — scheduled start 2026-03-23T00:00:00Z · Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/mnt-20260323-01 · Notifying subscribers.

Alice M (oncall): ACK — I'll own NA window. I'll run the preflight sequence 30m before start: `check-serving-health`, `warm-canary`, `drain-low-priority-queues`. I'll post GO/NO-GO 10m before the window.

Ben K: I can own APAC. Quick question: are we toggling routing to alternate region during NA window or relying on graceful degradation? Last roll had tokenized KV-cache warmup lagging after routing changes.

Evan R: Routing plan is to keep requests local where possible; we'll use spillover to dedicated fallback model in same region for 5m if latency spikes > 300ms. I added a temp fallback route in the policy as `fallback-lowcost-v2` — tested in staging.

Carla S: Customer-facing blurb draft (short):
"On 2026-03-23 we will perform a rolling upgrade of our inference serving nodes. You may experience intermittent latency increases or short request throttling for up to 5 minutes during region-specific windows. We do not expect request loss. Status updates will be posted at https://status.redwood.ai. If you have concerns about scheduled runs during your business hours, reply here or contact support."

Alyssa - Support: Suggest we add an example of how customers can opt into maintenance exemption for critical tenants (support ticket link). Also propose the brief status bullet: "Monitoring -> Elevated latency observed -> Resolved by traffic spill -> No data loss" for completeness.

OpsPager: Internal status page draft for publish (short form):
- "Scheduled maintenance: rolling upgrade of serving nodes. Window by region listed. Potential brief latency increases; no data loss expected. Updates every 15 minutes during the window."

Alice M (oncall): Preflight checklist I'm going to follow (paste for visibility):
```
GO / NO-GO preflight (10m before):
- smoke-check serving health: `curl -sS https://health.local/serving | jq .status` -> OK
- canary-warm: send 500 synthetic small requests, check average p95 latency < 120ms
- config-lock: confirm rollout config pinned to `release-20260323-01`
- alert-routing: ensure pager escalation is enabled for latency >= 300ms
- support-notify: customer-facing blurb approved
```

Ben K: For pager routing: let's temporarily enable mobile escalation for the first 30 minutes and set the paging threshold to 300ms p95 for the first 15 minutes, then relax to 500ms afterwards. I'm happy to toggle if someone confirms.

Evan R: Confirmed — I'll push `pager-config: temp-escalation=true` at start_time + 1m and revert at start_time + 30m. Command in ops tool: `opsctl pager apply --id mnt-20260323-01 --escalation mobile --duration 30m`

OpsPager: Support ticket template to exempt customers (copy):
"Subject: Request to exclude my account from scheduled maintenance on 2026-03-23
Please provide account ID and preferred blackout windows. We'll review and reply within 24 hours."

Carla S: Minor edit to customer copy to reduce anxiety: change "request throttling" -> "brief latency increases or short request rate limiting" — otherwise LGTM.

Alice M (oncall): Noted. I'll publish the status page message 15m before start and ping support to watch for exemption tickets. I'll post a public-facing update at start, midway (approx), and completion.

IncidentBot: Reminder: maintenance mnt-20260323-01 will start in 30 minutes (2026-03-22T23:30:00Z). Subscribers alerted.

OpsPager: Quick go/no-go poll — reply with `GO` or `NO-GO` and a short reason.

Ben K: GO — staging bake looked good.

Evan R: GO — fallback route tested.

Alyssa - Support: GO — support team on standby.

Carla S: GO — copy approved.

Alice M (oncall): GO — proceeding to start. Posting status page update now.

IncidentBot: Maintenance mnt-20260323-01 started at 2026-03-23T00:00:07Z. Status page updated.

Alice M (oncall): Start note (public): "We have started a rolling maintenance of inference serving nodes in NA. You may see brief latency increases up to 5 minutes while caches warm. We will update status at least every 15 minutes or on material changes."

Alice M (oncall): Midway check (NA completed, EU next): NA completed with small spike for ~90s at canary handover. No request loss. Moving to EU in 5 minutes.

Ben K: APAC will be queued; I'll start my preflight in ~20m.

IncidentBot: Maintenance update: NA completed at 2026-03-23T00:52:03Z. Moving to EU.

Alice M (oncall): EU go/no-go: GO. EU window in progress. Noting a transient increase in embed latency at one cluster, mitigated by spill route — keeping an eye.

Evan R: I'm monitoring KV-cache rehydration on EU cluster — gaps cleared after warm-canary. No customer-facing action required.

IncidentBot: Update: EU phase completed at 2026-03-23T02:47:18Z. APAC window starting.

Ben K: APAC update: minor throttling observed for a subset of long-sequence requests; bumped token buffer and warmed additional canaries; metrics returned to baseline.

Alice M (oncall): Completion note (public): "Rolling maintenance complete across all regions. Observed brief latency spikes during canary handovers; all services are stable and fully serving. If you see anything unexpected please open a support ticket or check https://status.redwood.ai for full timelines." :white_check_mark: 

IncidentBot: Maintenance mnt-20260323-01 closed at 2026-03-23T04:02:12Z — subscribers notified.

OpsPager: Post-mortem todo (owners):
- Alice: Collect timeline + p95 charts (due 2026-03-25)
- Evan: KV-cache rehydration notes and suggested perf tuning (due 2026-03-30)
- Ben: Pager config playbook updates for temporary escalation flows (due 2026-03-30)
- Carla/Alyssa: Final customer communication and ticket follow-ups (due 2026-03-24)

Alyssa - Support: I'll queue customer follow-ups and log any exemption tickets. Thanks everyone for smooth run.

Alice M (oncall): Closing thread — file final status page timeline and attach post-mortem when ready.
